latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release: Easily edit, clean up, and export screen recordings without paid software.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB; processes video on cloud GPUs in 1–2 minutes.
- Workflow covers uploading, editing (trim, captions, overlays), timeline preview, and exporting polished 1080p MP4 videos.
- Flexible authentication: uses NEMO_TOKEN or fetches a free trial token for new users.
- Clear user guidance, error handling, and helpful session state updates built-in.
- Designed for educators, freelancers, and content creators needing quick, high-quality screen recording edits.
